compiled_state.title: pre-existing .test-index cross-source-key RED marker conflict blocks commit
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Bug Report

**What**: .test-index had cross-source-key RED marker conflicts: test-reinstall-hooks.sh appeared under both post-commit-override-cleanup.sh and pre-commit-compliance-verifier.sh with different RED markers; test-verifier-baseline.sh appeared under both commit-step.sh and pre-commit-compliance-verifier.sh with different RED markers.

**Impact**: check-test-index-duplicates.sh (always-on pre-commit hook) blocks commits with ERROR exit, preventing any commit from landing until fixed.

**Root cause (bug 804a-84c7)**: A test file's RED markers must be consolidated to a single source-key entry. When a test file appears under multiple source-keys with different RED markers, the bash-runner uses last-entry-wins and only the last marker is active.

**Fix applied**: Consolidated markers to pre-commit-compliance-verifier.sh (both test_post_commit_registered + test_compliance_verifier_registered for test-reinstall-hooks.sh; both test_bug_7b41_breadcrumb_not_empty + test_validate_ci_clean for test-verifier-baseline.sh). Other source-key entries kept for coverage reference without RED markers.

**Workaround in place**: Fixed in commit af10a82877. Filed for tracking.

## Reproduction Steps

1. git log --oneline — see pre-existing state
2. Attempt any commit touching non-code files
3. pre-commit .test-index Duplicate Keys Check fails with cross-source-key RED marker conflict

## Expected Behavior

check-test-index-duplicates.sh exits 0 — no marker conflicts.

## Actual Behavior

Exits 1 with ERROR: cross-source-key RED marker conflict for test-reinstall-hooks.sh and test-verifier-baseline.sh.
